metadata.description: SanctifAI Trust — Proof of Human, and SanctifAI Source — Hire a Human. Dual sibling plugins; not one mega-plugin.

plugins.name: sanctifai-trust
plugins.description: Seal that a WebAuthn-authed human participated and attested an exact payload. Outsiders can verify the receipt without trusting your DB.

plugins.name: sanctifai-source
plugins.description: Ask registered marketplace workers (verify, escalate, consult, simulate) via MCP/REST and get structured answers back.
